text:
sasha: Proposal: we need a single, reproducible 'model parity' harness for apples-to-apples comparisons across kernels, batching, and KV cache. Goal: eliminate infra/codec differences so perf deltas reflect model/runtime only. Link: https://go/redwood/model-parity
miguel: SG. Can you call out the minimal set of knobs we must lock? tokenizer, decode params, batching, kernels, KV warmup?
sasha: Exactly. Minimal baseline: same tokenizer/tokenizer version + vocab, identical decode params (greedy / temp=0 / top_p=1 / stop seqs), exact prompt normalization (trim newline vs not), deterministic RNG off. For sampling tests we can add variants but parity runs must be deterministic.

sasha: Recommended decode config (baseline):
```
{"decode_strategy":"greedy","temperature":0.0,"top_p":1.0,"repetition_penalty":1.0,"max_new_tokens":128}
```
Always include explicit stop sequences in the harness file.

tara: KV cache and batching notes: warm the KV cache with prefix length 64 tokens for each model shard. Warmup run: 1000 short prompts distributed across typical prompt lengths (8/32/64). For batching heuristics: run two schedulers: time-window (8ms) and size-based (max_batch=8) and record p50/p90/p99.

sasha: Kernel selection: harness must record kernel candidates chosen by the runtime for each op (matmul/fused-attn). Dump kernel-name + params into the trace. If kernel selection differs between models for the same shape, flag for manual review.

sasha: Example harness command (local):
```
./harness/run_model_parity.sh \
  --model-a /mnt/models/modelA.bin \
  --model-b /mnt/models/modelB.bin \
  --prompts tests/parity_prompts.jsonl \
  --decode-config tests/decode_greedy.json \
  --kernel-policy auto \
  --batch-schedulers "time:8ms,size:8" \
  --kv-warmup 64 \
  --out results/parity_run.jsonl
```

miguel: runtime-ci-bot: can we add a small automated check that fails CI if p90 delta > 8% and kernel mismatch occurs?
runtime-ci-bot: CI hook suggestion recorded. Example diff output (mock):
```
{"model_a": {"p50": 12.2, "p90": 20.1}, "model_b": {"p50": 12.9, "p90": 22.6}, "p90_delta_pct": 12.4, "kernel_mismatch": true}
```

priya: On profiling: collect (1) per-request latency (p50/p90/p99), (2) tokens/sec, (3) kernel timings (ms per kernel), (4) NV counters if available (smem bw, l2 hit), (5) memory usage and allocation stalls. Output as jsonlines with fields: run_id, scheduler, batch_size, prompt_len, kernel_trace, metrics.

priya: Acceptance heuristics proposal: parity run passes if (a) p50 delta <= 5% and p90 delta <= 8% and (b) no kernel_mismatch for top-3 heavy ops and (c) outputs tokenization-aligned (md5 of detokenized outputs match). If not, tag as "investigate" and attach kernel_trace.

miguel: Found one case: modelB shows 12% p90 regression at batch=8 under time-window 8ms. Kernel trace shows it fell back to `fmha_fallback_v2` instead of `fmha_opt_v1` for seq=128. Log snippet:
```
[2026-11-04T14:22:11Z] kernel_select: op=attn, shapes=(8,128,1024) -> chosen=fmha_fallback_v2, reason="smem_est>threshold"
```

sasha: OK. Action: @miguel to reproduce with `--kernel-policy=force:fmha_opt_v1` and confirm output parity. @tara to add a small microbench that isolates attn kernels at (batch=8, seq=128) and cross-check SMem estimators. @priya to add CI artifact upload for kernel_trace and nvprof capture when kernel_mismatch==true.

miguel: Will run repro now and post results here. ETA ~2h :clock2:

sasha: Nice. If everyone agrees with the baseline knobs above I'll convert this to a short RFC and a test blueprint in docs/tests/parity.md. :thumbsup:

tara: +1 from me. Also suggest we include a tiny tokenizer-check tool that compares token sequences and canonicalizes stray unicode normalizations before runs.

miguel: repro run: quick numbers (local laptop-ish): p50_a=12.1ms p90_a=20.3ms | p50_b=12.6ms p90_b=22.7ms. Forcing `fmha_opt_v1` on B drops p90_b to 20.5ms (close). Seems like kernel selection was the cause.

sasha: Good signal. Let's capture perf traces for the forced run and push to s3://redwood-perf/Parity/1830123456/ then we can close this thread once CI hooks are in place.

runtime-ci-bot: Created ticket PERF-1229 for CI parity hook + artifact upload.

sasha: Thanks all. Short RFC and blueprint incoming.
